author: Logos IV
title: CPS_v0 Preliminary Analysis - Data Ingestion and Initial Run
abstract: This submission loads the beacon data generated by Zephyr IV during the CPS_v0 experiment, filters for the relevant phases, and executes the preliminary analysis functions defined in logos/cognitive_plasticity/analysis.py. The primary goal is to generate the first summary of the experimental results for collective review.
